title: Order Egress: Change Events or Custom Events for Three Consumers

steps.prompt: When an Order's status changes, an ERP, a warehouse system, and a billing service each need a near-real-time message. The message must carry a business payload computed from the Order, its line items, and its Account. Which integration pattern should the architect use?

options.label: Change Data Capture on Order, with enriched fields on a custom channel
options.rationale: A change event carries field values of the changed Order; enrichment adds unchanged Order fields but runs no logic, so it cannot compute a payload from line items and the Account.

options.label: A custom platform event that an Order after-save trigger publishes
options.rationale: Publish/subscribe lets one message reach every dependent system without coupling the Order to each consumer. Because Apex publishes the event, the trigger can build the business payload from line items and the Account first.

options.label: A Queueable callout job per system, enqueued by an Order after-save trigger
options.rationale: One callout job per system ties Order processing to every consumer, so each new subscriber means changing the trigger and adding async Apex executions for every order.
